findings.title: Delete never appears in the ruler-free list view
findings.body: canDelete is now true when Grafana Prometheus abilities allow delete, but the Delete menu item is still rendered only when rulerRule is set, and its click handler still requires that ruler DTO. GrafanaRuleListItem (the new list view) passes only promRule, so the item is never shown even for users with folder delete permission. The new GrafanaGroupLoader test grants AlertingRuleDelete and then asserts the menu has exactly four items and does not include Delete, so this regression is untested. Users can no longer delete Grafana rules from the alert list.

findings.title: Pause action is unreachable without a ruler rule
findings.body: Pause is shown only when canPause is true and rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) is true, then MenuItemPauseRule is given that ruler rule. The list view no longer loads ruler rules and only supplies promRule, so the pause item is never rendered even though useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities can set canPause. Pausing a Grafana-managed rule from the new list is impossible.

findings.title: Silence menu item does not open the drawer
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu can show Silence notifications from Grafana Prometheus abilities and calls handleSilence, which only sets showSilenceDrawer. The drawer itself is still gated on rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) and is passed rulerRule. In the list view rule is undefined, so clicking Silence does nothing. The new group-loader test only checks that the menu item exists, not that the drawer opens.

findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities used to set isFederated from isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group), which blocked update, delete, pause, restore, and permanent delete. After this refactor it always delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes isFederated to false (the source_tenants check is commented out and RuleGroupIdentifierV2 is not used to recover it). Federated Mimir/GEM rule groups can now be edited or deleted from every caller of the combined-rule ability hooks, not only the new list.

findings.title: Filtered Grafana rules are rendered without a list key
findings.body: The grafana branch of the filtered-results map used to pass key={key} into GrafanaRuleLoader. The replacement GrafanaRuleListItem element has no key, while the datasource and unknown branches still do. React will reuse the wrong row when the filter result set grows or shifts, so rule names, health, and action buttons can attach to the wrong rule. getRuleKey already exists for this list specifically to avoid duplicate keys.

findings.title: Rule view links drop the list returnTo
findings.body: The removed GrafanaRuleListItem built the view href with createReturnTo() so Back returned to the filtered or grouped list. The new item calls createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`) with no returnTo query. Opening a rule from the new list lands on the rule view with no way to return to the previous list filters or scroll position.

findings.title: Modify export is denied for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: useAllRulerRuleAbilities still enables ModifyExport for every Grafana-managed ruler rule (alerting and recording). useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities sets ModifyExport supported only when prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. Recording rules rendered from the Prometheus list therefore lose Export even when the user has AlertingRuleRead, which is what the list-view menu uses.
